groups.why_chosen: A node-by-round grid where colour alone marks which shard owns a cell, and pointer arrows chain same-colour cells into the ordering the text argues for.
groups.what_to_learn: Colour every grid cell by its shard chain, leave others blank, and draw pointer arrows only between same-colour cells, with leader cells in a third colour where several chains converge — but dense crossings blur exact endpoints.
